## Workload

Daniel Roche graded 254 sets during 412 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 0.6 per hour. The workload record indicates that the current session pattern was retained following review. No change to the established grading arrangement was identified in the review record.

The workload figures provide the basis for the quality check described below. They also clarify the relationship between the number of sets graded and the hours allocated for the work.

## Quality

A sample of 27 sets was read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement rate was 70.4 per cent. This provides the available measure of consistency between the original grading and the subsequent check.

The grader and reviewer agreed to keep the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Daniel Roche identified as the grader. The workload and quality information are recorded together for routine monitoring.
